name: Pelonite
overview: The term 'Pelonite' appears in Scripture as a designation linked to individuals from the tribe of Ephraim, as seen in 1 Chronicles 27:10 where Helez the Pelonite is identified as an Ephraimite captain. It is also used as an appellation for Ahijah the prophet (1 Chronicles 11:36), indicating a possible familial or regional association. Additionally, 1 Chronicles 11:27 references Helez the Pelonite among David's mighty men, further emphasizing the name's connection to notable figures within Israel's history.
